topic: The ancient map that revealed a 500-year-old conspiracy
hook: An ancient map revealed a conspiracy hidden for 500 years.
script: An ancient map revealed a conspiracy hidden for 500 years. The Piri Reis map, drawn in 1513, accurately shows the coastline of Antarctica — a continent not officially discovered until 1820. How? Some believe it was copied from even older maps. Maps from civilizations we have no record of. The answer has never been found. Follow for history's most unsettling mysteries.
